text:
In the first scene, gazing into the glass-walled room, a sense of stillness surrounds me. The space is orderly, yet empty—evoking thoughts about preparation, anticipation, or perhaps abandonment. The transparency of glass invites reflection on boundaries between openness and privacy.

Moving into the second scene, vivid colors and bold text stimulate my senses. The wall displays "R+D" and discusses human-machine coexistence and innovation. I am intrigued and intellectually engaged; this environment brings forth curiosity about the merging of ideas, technology, and humanity. These contrasting atmospheres make me ponder the interplay between contemplation and creative energy.
